lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: It's a good price and I've two children and a lease on the flour. You'd take it. Don't stand in my shop at four in the morning and tell me you wouldn't take it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Tollivers are paid, properly and legally, and they are fine. They stay fine. The corner burns in the spring regardless, because the fire was never about the building — the claim was always the point, and a claim is cheaper to settle than a freehold.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody did anything wrong. That's the bit that gets me. Every single person in that transaction behaved reasonably and the corner still burnt.
